display_text: Suppressed Power ** [[Alignment damage (weapon)#Axiomatic|Axiomatic]][[Alignment damage (weapon)#Axiomatic|Axiomatic]]: An axiomatic weapon is lawfully aligned and infused with the power of law. It makes the weapon law-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all of [[chaotic]] alignment.[[Category:Axiomatic items]] → [[Axiomatic Burst#Axiomatic Burst|Axiomatic Burst]][[Axiomatic Burst#Axiomatic Burst|Axiomatic Burst]]: An axiomatic weapon is lawfully aligned and infused with the power of law. It makes the weapon law-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of chaotic alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.[[Category:Axiomatic Burst items]] ** [[Bleed#Bleed|Bleed]][[Bleed#Bleed|Bleed]]: This weapon is cruelly sharp and will do an additional 1 to 8 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.[[Category:Bleed items]] → [[ Puncturing]][[ Puncturing]]: Critical hits by this weapon deal an extra 1 to 6 points of Constitution damage from blood loss.[[Category: Puncturing items]] ** [[Force_(enchantment)|Force]][[Force_(enchantment)|Force]]: This weapon is humming with magical force. It deals an additional 1 to 6 force damage on a successful hit.[[Category:Force items]] → [[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]][[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]]: This weapon is humming with magical force, and does 1 to 6 force damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 force damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.[[Category:Force Burst items]] ** [[Impact]][[Impact]]: Passive: The base critical [[Threat range|threat range]] of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with [[Improved Critical]] feat. [[Vorpal Strike]]s by this weapon also bypass all [[Fortification]].[[Category:Impact items]] → [[Maiming]][[Maiming]]: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 1 to 6, x3 - 2 to 12, x4 - 3 to 18.[[Category:Maiming items]] ** [[Shock|Shock]][[Shock|Shock]]: This weapon is sheathed in crackling electricity. A shock weapon deals an extra 1 to 6 points of electricity damage on a successful hit.[[Category:Shock items]] → [[Shocking Burst#Shocking Burst|Shocking Burst]][[Shocking Burst#Shocking Burst|Shocking Burst]]: This weapon is sheathed in crackling electricity, and deals 1 to 6 electric damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 electric damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.[[Category:Shocking Burst items]] ** Becomes [[Bind|Bound to Character on Acquire]][[Category:Binds to character]][[Category:Binds on acquire]][[Category:Suppressed Power items]]
